cache_policy: Production caches as-is (cache/cache.db, 7-30 day TTLs by source). Degraded states are never cached by design. No cache clearing, pinning, or special treatment for the scored run.
health_requirements: All three pool jobs resolvable via api.jobs_db in completed/awaiting_review state with persisted candidates files
rerun_allowance: one-fix-one-rerun for a proven harness defect, recorded in results
